detail.longDescription: AI writes your code at 10× speed. Prelint makes sure it's the right code - it reviews every PR against your ADRs, docs and past decisions, and catches product drift before it ships. On teams using several AI reviewers, ~40% of the issues fixed before merge are caught by Prelint.
